description: You are the District Health Information Officer for Bo District, Sierra Leone. The Provincial Health Management Team has requested a malaria burden analysis for their quarterly review meeting. Using DHIS2 at http://localhost:8080 (login: admin / district), create a new dashboard named 'Bo District Malaria Burden 2023'. This dashboard must contain at least three visualization items: (1) A bar or column chart showing monthly confirmed malaria cases (use RDT positive or confirmed cases data elements) for Bo district for the full year 2023 — save this visualization as a favorite named 'Bo Malaria Monthly Cases 2023'; (2) A pivot table showing malaria-related indicator data (tested and/or positive counts) broken down by quarter for Bo district for 2023 — save this as a favorite named 'Bo Malaria Positivity Quarterly 2023'; (3) A thematic or choropleth map showing malaria case distribution across Bo district facilities for 2023 — save this map as 'Bo Malaria Facility Map 2023'. Add all three saved visualizations to the dashboard and save the dashboard.
